limitations: Configuration files restore settings and the explanation chapter; they do not persist computed models or every transient query/replay position.
Reopening recomputes matching frozen, generated or embedded CSV inputs and adapters; unavailable revisions are rejected.
Browser-local storage is scoped to the current origin; portable files provide independent copies.
No release-scope waiver, final-check evaluation, hosted sharing service, or public deployment is implied.
CSV source is embedded in saved/portable configurations and JSON/SVG metadata; output rows omit reserved predictions.

Parameter history is transient, capped at 20 changes per active context and resets on data/model/protocol changes, saved experiment opening or page reload. It does not persist earlier computed models.
Guided notes are transient in the current page. Worksheets contain recorded evidence rather than a live fit, without automatic grading, embedded CSV source or imported computed models.

illustrationMotion.regression: computed least-squares endpoint; vertical residuals anchored to fixed observations at every frame
illustrationMotion.pca: dominant covariance direction through sample mean; orthogonal projections; fixed observations
illustrationMotion.scrollEntrances: headings, subtitles and content blocks; no chart/control ancestor transforms
illustrationMotion.reducedMotion: final static geometry; all content visible; running motion canceled
illustrationMotion.lifecycle: one shared observer pair and frame loop; offscreen and detached icons stop; carousel tweens disposed on navigation

ambientContours.rendering: smoothed scalar-field contours rendered in an OffscreenCanvas module worker; optimized main-thread fallback if unsupported or worker startup/runtime fails
ambientContours.cursorBehavior: independent display-frame loop; faster contraction toward cursor; three successive steps; no native cursor replacement; pointer-events none
ambientContours.inputProtection: hide during press/drag; ignore touch movement; opaque teaching charts
ambientContours.lifecycle: suspend hidden/pagehide; reuse on route changes; resize-aware
ambientContours.geometry: reusable typed buffers; integer grid-edge joins; frame-shared basin trigonometry
ambientContours.scheduling: deadline-preserving 30 Hz animation-frame sampling; timer fallback where worker rAF is unavailable
ambientContours.telemetry: low-frequency frame count; no per-frame worker-to-DOM updates

experimentSharing.recipient: review first; explicit open/save; run separately
